name: Honor Your Wife
overview: Scripture reveals that God designed the wife as a suitable helper and companion for the husband, establishing the foundation for marital unity where two become one flesh. A husband is called not only to love his wife sacrificially, as Christ loved the church, but also to honor her as part of himself, recognizing the blessing and favor that comes from finding a wife. This honor includes guarding one's heart against lust, reflecting a commitment to purity and respect within the marriage relationship.
